journey.name: Discard drafts while offline, and they stay gone on reconnect
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in, online, and no draft with the subject "Offline discard journey" or "Saved draft discard journey" exists in Drafts. A draft written offline is kept on the device until the connection returns. Discarding it must remove that copy, so nothing reaches the server. Discarding a draft the server already has, while offline, must close the composer and remove the draft once the connection returns.

actions.action: Swipe down from the very top edge of the screen twice to open Quick Settings, and tap "Airplane mode" to turn it on
Close Quick Settings
Verify that the banner at the top of the inbox reads "Offline"
Tap the round compose button with the pencil icon at the bottom right of the screen
Verify that a "New message" composer is shown with "To" and "Subject" fields and a trash can button to discard the draft
Tap the "To" field and type "maya@acme.test", then tap the "Subject" field
Type "Offline discard journey" into the "Subject" field
Verify that the composer reads "Saved on this device" within a few seconds
Verify that the trash can button is visible on the screen and not covered by the keyboard; hide the keyboard with the Back button if it is covered
Tap the trash can button to discard the draft
Verify that the composer closes, the inbox is shown, and "Draft discarded." appears near the bottom of the screen
Verify that the banner at the top reads "Offline" and says no changes are waiting
Swipe down from the very top edge of the screen twice to open Quick Settings, and tap "Airplane mode" to turn it off
Close Quick Settings and wait 15 seconds
Verify that the banner is gone
Tap the round compose button with the pencil icon at the bottom right of the screen
Tap the "Subject" field and type "Saved draft discard journey"
Verify that the composer reads "Saved" within a few seconds
Swipe down from the very top edge of the screen twice to open Quick Settings, and tap "Airplane mode" to turn it on
Close Quick Settings
Verify that the trash can button is visible on the screen and not covered by the keyboard; hide the keyboard with the Back button if it is covered
Tap the trash can button to discard the draft
Verify that the composer closes and "Draft discarded." appears near the bottom of the screen
Verify that the banner at the top reads "Offline" followed by "1 change waiting"
Swipe down from the very top edge of the screen twice to open Quick Settings, and tap "Airplane mode" to turn it off
Close Quick Settings and wait 15 seconds
Verify that the banner is gone
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Drafts" in the drawer
Verify that no draft with the subject "Offline discard journey" or "Saved draft discard journey" is listed in Drafts
